_note: Curated seed registry of x402-priced APIs verified to return a valid 402 challenge on Base mainnet. CI runs verify-seed nightly to flag broken entries. Discovery in pay.discover federates this seed with external indexes (CDP Bazaar, agentic.market, x402watch, 402directory.com); the directory has been the de facto live source since the v0.5 cleanup of stale seeds. Add curated entries here only if they need to be available with X402_FEDERATION=off. To submit a community entry, list at https://402directory.com/submit instead.

entries.name: x402-extract — article extraction
entries.description: Fetches a URL and returns the extracted article as JSON: cleaned title, meta description, markdown, and plain text. Deterministic Readability-based extraction, no LLM.
